exposure: HOMA-IR (homeostatic model assessment for insulin resistance)
HOMA-b (homeostatic model assessment for b cell function)
cohort: The study included 482 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) during pregnancy.
finding: Increased HOMA-IR (insulin resistance) was significantly associated with a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes (OR 1.34 for each 1-unit increase), while higher HOMA-b (b cell function) was associated with a lower risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes (OR 0.57 for each 1-unit increase).
cross-section timing: During pregnancy (when quantitative metrics on b cell function and insulin sensitivity were calculated)
